stories.headline: Tech selloff deepens as AI doubts drive rush into Treasuries
stories.summary: A renewed rout in technology shares showed no sign of letting up as investors questioned the artificial-intelligence growth outlook, pushing US stock futures sharply lower for a second day. The flight from risk sent money into US Treasuries, which rallied across the curve as haven demand surged.

stories.headline: Core PCE inflation rises 0.3% for third straight month, complicating Fed outlook
stories.summary: US consumer spending stalled in October after a strong surge earlier in the year, while core PCE inflation rose 0.3% for a third consecutive month, up 3.3% year-over-year, the fastest pace since 2023. The data reinforces expectations that the Fed may need to keep rates higher for longer, and comes as gold and risk assets sell off.

stories.headline: Nvidia still faces issues that have cost $2 trillion in market value
stories.summary: Despite CEO Jensen Huang's active leadership, Nvidia investors continue to grapple with concerns that have wiped roughly $2 trillion off the chipmaker's market value. The stock remains at the center of the broader AI-trade anxiety roiling tech markets.

stories.headline: Goldman strategist says it's too early to buy the AI selloff
stories.summary: A Goldman Sachs strategist cautioned that investors need to see real profits from the billions being spent building AI infrastructure before calling a bottom in the selloff. The comment reflects a cautious Wall Street stance as the tech rout extends into a second day.

stories.headline: Gold slumps below $3,500 on rate-hike outlook and AI stock selloff
stories.summary: Gold fell below $3,500 an ounce as the equity selloff continued and the latest inflation print reinforced expectations the Fed could keep raising or holding rates higher. The move came alongside broader risk-off trading across metals, with copper, aluminum and tin also sliding toward bear-market territory.

stories.headline: Equity meltdown spreads to carry trade, denting one of 2026's reliable wagers
stories.summary: The stock market selloff is spilling into currency carry trades, which have been one of Wall Street's most consistent winning strategies in 2026. The spillover signals that AI-driven risk aversion is broadening beyond equities into other asset classes.

stories.headline: Embraer shares sink almost 10% after US proposes Brazil aircraft tariff
stories.summary: Embraer SA shares fell nearly 10% in Sao Paulo, their worst drop since May, after the US proposed an additional 10% tariff on Brazilian aircraft. The move adds to trade-policy pressure on Brazilian exporters and comes as the US prepares broader tariff hikes.

stories.headline: Dangote Refinery set to list in Lagos on December 1 in Africa's largest IPO
stories.summary: Billionaire Aliko Dangote's oil refinery is expected to start trading in Lagos as soon as next week, in an operation valued at roughly $48 billion through its IPO. The listing would be the largest primary offering in Africa's history.
